text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"It looks like the included photo was 
taken this morning\nwhen Beauty-san was 
explaining the rules to us."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "Huh...? Why is this...?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Rice-san, did you notice something?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Um... this might be totally unrelated, 
but...\nFor some reason, the pendulum 
clock in this room doesn't have any 
hands..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"But you see...\nThe clock in this photo 
clearly has hands on it."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "!! Indeed, good catch!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe. And these hands... Rice feels like 
she's seen them somewhere before...\nAh—!"

text_block_list.name: Rice & Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Urara-chan, could these be!\nRice-chan, 
could these be!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"!! I see, hands for a pendulum clock! If 
so,\njust as 'at the right time, in the 
right place' suggests, if we attach the 
hands...!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Let's try it!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Nothing... is happening.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehhh, whyyyy?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I guess Rice was just mistaken after 
all...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"What should we do... Rice said the wrong 
thing...\nWe're going to run out of time, 
aren't we... I'm so sorry."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Rice-san, it's okay.\nIt's times like 
this where panicking is the worst thing to 
do."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"That's right. There's no doubt that these 
are clock hands.\nIf we got something 
wrong, it's either how or the order in 
which we attached them, or else—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...It's the wrong clock to begin with, 
perhaps?\n—Ah, I see. That's what it was."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aha. Looks like Curren figured it out too♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Fine-san, since we're both here, 
want to say it together?\nThe answer to 
the 'Final Riddle' is—ready, go—"

text_block_list.name: Fine & Curren
text_block_list.text:
There's another room somewhere other than 
this one!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh...?! W-What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, when listening to Beauty-san 
explain the rules this morning,\nI thought 
it looked like something—what do you think 
it was?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It was a 'social media livestream'♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"When doing a livestream, depending on the 
person, many people\nrecord using the 
front camera just like when taking a 
'selfie', right?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And footage from a front camera is usually 
mirrored—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Which means the video is 'horizontally 
flipped'!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"So somewhere in this hotel, there must be 
a room\nwhere the left and right sides are 
flipped, just like a mirror image of this 
photo, right?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see! So that's how you figured it out, 
Curren-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As for me, I was thinking back to the 
hotel staff member who guided us earlier.

text_block_list.name: Hotel Concierge
text_block_list.text:
"Now then, first... please step inside 
here.\n—Right this way."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The staff here are exceptionally 
well-trained, you see. Their guidance was 
flawlessly smart and efficient.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why it struck me as odd. 
Why was she so nervous when she said the 
word "First"?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I figured Ms. Beauty must have scripted 
her lines. That's why a hint of tension 
crept into her voice. "First," in this 
room—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, then next—?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Once I realized that, the rest was simple. 
The floor guide I saw this morning showed 
another room of the exact same size.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's amazing, Fine-san! Curren didn't 
notice that at all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I think both of your deductions 
were brilliant, though. —Let's hurry, time 
is almost up.

text_block_list.name: Hotel Concierge
text_block_list.text:
Right this way, please—allow me to guide 
you.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! The room really is completely 
flipped upside down!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan, let's put the clock hands in!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, the clock in the photograph was 
mirrored, so please be careful with the 
positions of the hands!

text_block_list.name: Rice's Group
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Found it, everyone! Inside the clock... 
This has got to be the key to the 
church...!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
TRÈS BIIIIIIEEEEEEN!! 
You girls got every single answer right!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to witness your 
proposals! I'll be waiting at the church!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yay! Let's go, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No need to rush, you two. All we have left 
to do is make our way to the church.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, we finally solved it "cutely"♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Cutely"... Yeah, you're right. Everyone 
gave it their all with so much 
excitement—it was a wonderful 
puzzle-solving adventure.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Now it's Ms. Beauty's turn next. I can't 
wait to see how she expresses all of our 
"cuteness"... I'm so excited♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ms. Beauty's turn?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yup♪ After all, we showed Ms. Beauty our 
"ideals." How she shapes them into 
reality—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
What kind of Racewear those received 
"ideals" become... That's what Ms. 
Beauty's work is all about, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'd be in trouble if it wasn't! Because 
Curren came here to become even "cuter" 
with "cute" Racewear.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Racewear meant to help you become your 
"ideal" self...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see... I finally get it. Why everyone 
seeks out Ms. Beauty's Racewear.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's why... That's why right now, I feel 
so—
